transcript.text: Hi everyone. Thanks for joining the go-live review. As we know, the self-serve API-key rotation workflow passed staging and is scheduled for production launch next Monday. Before I give final approval on the launch policy, I need to hear from each of you on any operational or customer-facing requirements. The current draft enables the workflow for all eligible customers, gives a 24-hour transition period, provides no advance customer notice, and retains ordinary rotation logs for 30 days. Let's start with backend engineering — any concerns or requirements on your end?
